'''Elena Vladimirovna Boldyreva''' (born 4 February 1961) is a Russian chemist. Boldyreva is a leading researcher at the [[Boreskov Institute of Catalysis]] in the Siberian Branch of [[Russian Academy of Sciences]], and is Professor and Head of the Section of Solid State Chemistry at [[Novosibirsk State University]].

== Early life and education ==
Boldyreva was born in [[Tomsk]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=1G93BQAAQBAJ&dq=2012+Academina.+Women+in+Science.+boldyreva&pg=PA30|title=Who is Who in Thermal Analysis and Calorimetry|last1=Szilágyi|first1=Imre Miklós|last2=Liptay|first2=György|date=2014-11-18|publisher=Springer|isbn=9783319094861|language=en}}</ref> She attended secondary school #130 and graduated with a gold medal in 1977.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www.sazu.si/en/members/jelena-vladimirovna-boldireva|title=Jelena Vladimirovna Boldireva|website=www.sazu.si|language=en|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref> She studied at the [[Novosibirsk State University]], and earned her bachelor's degree in 1982 and PhD in [[physical chemistry]] in 1988.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=V. Boldyreva|first1=Elena|last2=A. Zakharov|first2=Boris|date=2019|title=High pressure: a complementary tool for probing solid-state processes|journal=CrystEngComm|language=en|volume=21|issue=1|pages=10–22|doi=10.1039/C8CE01391H|s2cid=106390139}}</ref> Boldyreva worked at the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] from 1980.

== Research and career ==
Boldyreva was awarded an additional [[Doctorate in Science]] in [[solid-state chemistry]] in 2000.<ref name=":0" /> She was promoted to Professor at the [[Novosibirsk State University]] in 2003.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://sciact.catalysis.ru/en/public/profile/2028|title=Boldyreva Elena Vladimirovna {{!}} Sciact - CRIS-system of Boreskov Institute of Catalysis - publications, employee|website=sciact.catalysis.ru|language=en|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref> Her early work considered photomechanical effects in crystals of [[coordination complex]]es. She shifted into [[high pressure]] research, working with [[infrared spectroscopy]] at the [[Phillips University]] in [[Marburg]]. Boldyreva has investigated solid [[pharmaceutical]] compounds and [[Biomimetics|biomimetic]] molecules. She also worked at [[Durham University]] as a [[Royal Society]] Fellow.<ref name=":1" />

She uses high pressure measurements to investigate and control the inter- and intra-molecular interactions in crystals.<ref name=":1" /> She has shown you can use pressure to induce new crystalline forms, as well as interrogating chemical reactions.<ref name=":1" /> Alongside experimental science, Boldyreva works on [[Monte Carlo method|Monte Carlo]] simulations for [[Solid-state chemistry|solid-state]] reactions.

She serves on the advisory council of the [[Russian Ministry of Education and Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Boldyreva_Elena/CV|title=Academy of Europe: CV|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref>

She is an editor for [[Acta Crystallographica]], [[International Union of Crystallography]] Research Journal, [[CrystEngComm]] [[Journal of Thermal Analysis and Calorimetry]] and Pharmalogica.<ref name="scripts.sasg.ed.ac.uk">{{Cite web|url=http://www.scripts.sasg.ed.ac.uk/registry/Graduations/GraduateDetails.cfm?ID=3525|title=Honorary graduate details {{!}} The University of Edinburgh|website=www.scripts.sasg.ed.ac.uk|access-date=2019-06-18|archive-date=2020-06-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200613192318/http://www.scripts.sasg.ed.ac.uk/registry/Graduations/GraduateDetails.cfm?ID=3525|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/crystengcomm/editorial-board-members/|title=crystengcomm_editorial board members|website=www.rsc.org|language=en-GB|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref>

=== Awards and honours ===
Her awards and honours include;

* 2007 Award from the European Society for Applied Physical Chemistry<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.htt.nsu.ru/?page_id=9&lang=en|title=Staff|language=en-US|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref>
* 2008 Elected to the [[International Union of Crystallography]]
* 2012 ''Academina Women in Science<ref name=":0" />''
* 2017 Elected to the [[Slovenian Academy of Sciences and Arts]]<ref name=":1" />
* 2018 [[University of Edinburgh]] Honorary degree of Doctor of Science<ref name="scripts.sasg.ed.ac.uk"/>
* 2018 Elected to the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Boldyreva_Elena|title=Academy of Europe: Boldyreva Elena|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2019-06-18}}</ref>
